prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original extra-wide finite horizontal panorama for a Chinese fantasy chibi RPG. Create one single continuous panoramic landscape with a TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, aspect ratio 3:1, approximately 2304x768 pixels. Rendering: richly painted soft watercolor and gouache with fine warm brown ink contours, handcrafted storybook game background. Scenic silhouettes and plants should feel vertically tall in the source because this wide source will be resized to runtime 2080x280. All open sky MUST be genuine clear alpha, no sky color, no paper rectangle, no gradient backdrop. Continuous nearly level pale warm stone-and-dirt walking lane spans EVERY pixel of the full width at proportional character foot baseline y=88% of canvas height. Its surface should occupy y=83% to95%, with low roots and earth below through the bottom edge. NO alpha gaps in the walking ground, no drop-offs, no stairs, no cliffs in the lane. Only scenic objects behind the lane; all foreground rocks and grasses low. Compose an original long environment with varied asymmetrical landmark heights and intervals, never mirror, duplicate, tile, or repeat scenery. Left and rightmost 5% only sparse low plants and the same flat path. Rich but readable landmark shapes, generous open transparent areas in upper half between groups. No characters, monsters, text, letters, UI, watermark, frames or border. Route theme: Creek Bridge. A peaceful jade-green mountain stream crossed by a broad low old stone bridge that forms part of the LEVEL walk lane in the middle, with no raised arch. Transparent open air above. Behind it a narrow turquoise brook meanders among differently shaped mossy riverstones. On the left third a small graceful willow with long hanging leaves; just right of center a broken stone lantern and fern bank; towards right three-quarters a taller uneven willow-and-bamboo cluster. Water peeks behind and below the bridge but never replaces solid walking surface. Warm ochre masonry, jade moss, turquoise water, bright morning woodland feeling. Distinctive natural asymmetry and uninterrupted ground.
